title: Official Code of Georgia Annotated, Title 34 (Labor and Industrial Relations), Chapter 1 — General Provisions
verified_how: read the register's own table of contents in a browser: 'CHAPTER 1 General Provisions (§§ 34-1-1 — 34-1-10)' under Title 34, so § 34-1-10 (the Family Care Act) is within the live section range.
notes: in_force 'unclear' for the same CAPTCHA reason as above. Georgia mandates no paid leave and no holiday pay; § 34-1-10 only requires employers who already provide sick leave to let employees use up to five days of it for family care. Family and medical leave generally is federal (FMLA, 29 U.S.C. ch. 28).
